resources.string: Start on this TV with your own media sources. Connect your Omnia server when you want to sync profiles, your library and watch progress across devices.
Connect your server before signing in.
Your account and synced data are stored on the server you connect.
You will be signed out and the app will restart with its original configuration. You can continue using this TV without an account.
OpenSubtitles v3 supplies external subtitles for movies and episodes. Install it here, then choose a subtitle from the player. Other subtitle add-ons can be added using their manifest URL above.
